text:
Kori (Growth): Hey team — need a compact 'snackable' asset bundle for next week's benchmark webinar + launch email. Tight timeline: final assets by EOD Wed. Reuse parts of the benchmark kit where possible. :hourglass:

Riley (Design): Can you define 'snackable'? sizes, variants, and any mandatory copy? :eyes:

Kori (Growth): Keep it minimal: 4 social images (carousel + single), 1 email hero, 1 animated microtile for landing, 3 subject-line options, 3 CTA variants. Emphasize brand compliance and quick editability.

Maya P.: Which stat do we call out? Attendees care about latency & cost. Suggest: "avg latency: 42ms per token" + a short cost blurb: "~2x cheaper vs baseline".

Kori (Growth): Yes, surface those two lines. Social copy needs to be <= 280 chars, snappy.

Riley (Design): Draft spec: social sizes 1200x628 (LinkedIn), 1080x1080 (feed), 1080x1920 (stories), 1200x675 (Twitter wide). Email hero 1200x400. Microtile 600x600 GIF, ~3s loop. Deliverables: PNG + SVG for static, GIF + MP4 for motion, Figma file, and a README with export instructions.

Riley (Design): Export naming: benchmark-snack-<YYYYMMDD>-<asset>-v1.{png,svg,gif,mp4}. Include retina (2x) PNGs.

Sam O.: Brand notes: use primary blue + neutral overlays; avoid the neon sketch. Add 1px safe margin for token overlays. Include plain-white background versions for press.

Leo (Design Ops): Please use component instances per size in Figma, and consistent layer names. Accessibility check: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text.

Kori (Growth): Timeline: announcement Thu 9am PT. Wed EOD handoff preferred. If any blocker, escalate to me immediately.

Riley (Design): Plan: wireframes today, initial comps Tue afternoon, final Wed EOD. Will tag @Kori @Maya @Sam for copy + brand sign-off.

assets-bot: Placeholder board uploaded — https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/benchmark-snack-pack. Use as working file. :rocket:

Maya P.: Copy ideas (subject lines): 1) "New inference benchmarks: faster + cheaper" 2) "How we cut avg latency by 2x" 3) "Benchmark highlights: speed & cost". Will craft social variants after seeing comps.

Kori (Growth): CTA options to include: [Explore the report], [See pricing & perf], [Watch the short demo]. We'll finalize at handoff.

Riley (Design): Noted. Uploading initial comps to the figma link in a few hours. Any other must-have assets before I start?

Sam O.: One more: include export presets for 1x and 2x, and a plain-white background pack. Also add a small 600x200 banner for partner embeds.

Riley (Design): Will add the 600x200 banner. Thanks — I'll keep replies short here and DM if blocked. :thumbsup:
